# Perfect London Massage

> Professional mobile massage in London. Qualified therapists deliver deep tissue, Thai, sports, Swedish and more to your home, hotel or office. Open 7 days, 09:00–21:30 (last appointment 23:00). Rates from £65/hr. Book by phone, text or WhatsApp.

## About

Perfect London Massage is a mobile massage service covering London and surrounding areas including Kent and Hertfordshire. Therapists are dispatched to homes, hotels and offices across Central London (W1), North, East, West and South London — typically within 30–45 minutes in Zones 1–2, or within the hour elsewhere.

Every therapist is qualified (certified in their specialisation plus anatomy & physiology) and vetted. Therapists bring natural almond or grapeseed oils; clients provide two clean towels. Treatments are given on the bed or the floor — therapists do not carry a massage table.

Rates: Luxury Massage £65/60min · Massage Bliss £80/90min · Massage Overload £100/120min · Heaven Massage £140/180min. Travel supplement: £15 Zones 1–3, £20 Zones 4–6 & Heathrow. £20 late-night fee after 21:30.
